MINI MINUTES: APPEARANCES:

Luke Garvey; 415-956-8100; Zacks, Freedman & Chernev, PC; counsel appearing for plaintiff.
David Silverman; 561-400-8798; defendant appearing in pro per.

Mr. Silverman contests the courts tentative ruling. Argued. Mr. Silverman's filings of August 17, 2026 are striken as untimely. After reviewing the pleadings and listening to oral arguments the Court adopts the tentative ruling as follows:

DEFENDANT Silverman's Motion for Summary Judgment or, in the Alternative, Summary Adjudication is DENIED. By this action, Plaintiff seeks to recover possession from an unknown person, not from Defendant Silverman, who had a license to occupy the premises. Plaintiff's Complaint alleges that Doe 1, a specific person whose name is unknown, unlawfully entered the premises on or about May 7, 2026. Defendant Silverman's motion, based on Plaintiff's filings only, fails to meet the initial burden of showing that Plaintiff cannot prevail on its cause of action for forcible detainer as against Doe 1.

Order signed. Judge: Samuel K. Feng; Clerk: L. Young ; Not Reported. (D501)
